The '''Gamefinders''' were a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] government faction of the [[Bosph (species)|Bosph]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Bosph/Legends|Bosph]]. The faction was part of a hierarchy of Force-sensitive factions that made up all of Bosph government and ruled over the planet. Each faction would take any Bosph found to be Force sensitive, known as [[ela b'Yentarr]], at a young age and apprentice them to a member of the group, with each faction training their members in different aspects of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The Gamefinders specialized in [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] which would aid them in hunting such as [[Life Detection|life detection]], [[Psychometry/Legends|postcognition]], and [[Sense Path|sense path]]. Like most ela b'Yentarr many Gamefinders were killed during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] bombardment of Bosph.<ref name="AE" />
